name: Get contact workflows
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the active workflow instances that a specific contact is participating in. Use a workflow‑listing action (e.g., list all workflows) instead when you only need workflow definitions without tying them to a particular contact.
preconditions: The contact with the given ID must exist.

id.description: The unique identifier of the contact.

outputs.description: Details of the workflows the contact is currently in. The exact shape is not publicly documented, so additional fields may be present.
